reason: Organizer CRM needs immutable contact-source provenance and participant-controlled permission evidence. Mutable preference state and compatibility source summaries cannot prove how a contact or communication grant entered the system.

phases.description: Add server-only schemas, generated types, contract inventory, and direct-access denial.
Manual Customers creation, reviewed Host Form CRM conversion, and attendee projection append deterministic contact origins; public registration and inbound STOP append immutable permission receipts.
Managed campaign previews, dispatch, projections, and summaries require a complete referenced grant. Organizer suppression remains a separate operational state.

The dry-run-first tool creates origins only from canonical attendee edges and completed reviewed Host Form CRM conversion receipts, reports unresolved contact/origin gaps, and marks legacy non-unknown permission state incomplete. It never infers a grant from a phone, source label, ordinary form consent or answer, roster, or prior send.

environmentEvidence.dev: Not mutated. The backfill is dry-run by default.
environmentEvidence.prod: Not mutated. --apply --allow-prod remains an explicit separate operation after review of a production dry run.

rulesAndIndexes.firestoreRules: Both new collections deny direct client reads and writes.
rulesAndIndexes.firestoreIndexes: The backfill uses collection scans; runtime merge queries currentContactId and require the generated index inventory to remain current.
